image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a large, iridescent soap bubble being held or formed by human fingers. The bubble dominates the frame, displaying vibrant rainbow interference patterns (greens, pinks, blues) and significant optical distortion of the background. Smaller satellite bubbles are visible near the bottom left. The background is blurred, suggesting a shallow depth of field.

The edge of the bubble bleeds into the background and the finger without a sharp occlusion boundary, creating a 'melting' effect typical of diffusion models struggling with transparent objects.
